maddeler.e:
تكافلت (form VI)
# تَكَافَلْتُ (takāfaltu) /ta.kaː.fal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# تَكَافَلْتَ (takāfalta) /ta.kaː.fal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# تَكَافَلْتِ (takāfalti) /ta.kaː.fal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَافَلَ (takāfala)
# تَكَافَلَتْ (takāfalat) /ta.kaː.fa.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
